title: English Practice Quiz 0874
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: If a task is 'urgent', it needs ___.
questions.explanation: Urgent means requiring immediate or prompt attention.

questions.question: ___ I borrow your pen, please?
questions.explanation: May is a polite way to ask permission.

questions.question: Which word has the /ʃ/ sound as in 'ship'?
Choose the correct question tag: 'You are ready, ___?'
questions.explanation: A positive statement with are usually takes the negative tag aren't you.

questions.question: Choose the passive form: 'The manager signed the letter.'
options: The letter was signed by the manager.
questions.explanation: Past simple passive: was/were + past participle.

questions.question: She arrived ___.
questions.explanation: Late is the correct adverb meaning not on time.

questions.question: Listen! The baby ___.
questions.explanation: Listen! suggests an action happening now, so use the present continuous.

questions.question: A place where medicines are dispensed is a ___.
questions.explanation: A pharmacy is a place where medicines are prepared or supplied.

questions.question: It ___ rain later; take an umbrella.
Read: 'The shop closes at 9 p.m., but it opens at 10 a.m.' When does it open?
questions.explanation: The opening time given is 10 a.m.
